interface.shortDescription: OMC-style workflow, planning, QA, review, benchmark, and runtime policy skills for Codex.
interface.longDescription: A Codex-native workflow pack inspired by oh-my-claudecode. It ports durable orchestration ideas into installable Codex skills, adds Codex-safe setup and ops workflows, enforces OMC activation/context/artifact policy, and includes a deterministic benchmark for local effectiveness checks while intentionally omitting Claude-specific hook and slash-command runtimes.
